one_line: A modern historian of mathematics investigating whether Kerala’s pre-calculus series reached Europe.

appearance.face: oval face, medium brown Kerala complexion, sharp observant eyes with thin rectangular glasses, neat short beard and moustache, slightly arched eyebrows, default expression calm and thoughtful with a hint of determined curiosity
appearance.hair: short, slightly wavy black hair neatly combed back, small center part, no headwear
appearance.costume: simple off-white cotton shirt with long sleeves rolled to mid-forearm, buttoned but collar open; over it a dark navy sleeveless Nehru-style waistcoat; sand-coloured cotton mundu (Kerala dhoti) with a thin maroon border, pleated and reaching the ankles; brown leather belt subtly holding a side pouch; plain brown leather sandals; a slim silver wristwatch on the left hand and a thin black pen clipped to the shirt placket
appearance.signature: a worn tan leather notebook held in the left hand, half-open to show dense sketched series and timelines, with a single bookmark ribbon in deep red; in the right hand a slender mechanical pencil poised as if annotating

ref_desc: A mid-30s Kerala math historian with short wavy black hair, glasses, off-white shirt, navy Nehru waistcoat, sand mundu with maroon border, brown sandals, carrying a tan leather notebook and pencil in a palette of off-white, navy, sand, brown and maroon.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of a mid-30s Kerala historian of mathematics: oval medium-brown face, short wavy black hair neatly combed back, thin rectangular glasses, neat short beard, expression calm and inquisitive. He wears an off-white long-sleeved cotton shirt with sleeves rolled to mid-forearm, a dark navy sleeveless Nehru-style waistcoat, and a sand-coloured cotton mundu with a thin maroon border, pleated and reaching his ankles, paired with simple brown leather sandals. A slim silver wristwatch sits on his left wrist and a thin black pen is clipped to his shirt placket. In his left hand he holds a worn tan leather notebook half-open, pages filled with faint sketches of mathematical series and timelines, with a single deep red bookmark ribbon; in his right hand he holds a slender mechanical pencil as if ready to annotate. Use a coherent palette of off-white, navy blue, sand, brown and maroon, and show him front-facing in a neutral standing pose with clear view of face, hair, clothing details and notebook.
